Exact colorings of contracted G/Z count the vertex labels; summing over arrow coefficients proves the full rank polynomial. The characteristic polynomial of the contracted cycle matroid proves q^{-c(G)} invariance. A forest factors edge-by-edge. Rank m iff each color-induced subgraph is a forest, equivalent to vertex arboricity at most q. For K5 q=2 an equitable 2+3 split has one monochromatic cycle; maximum is exactly 9.
